item.title: Make Those Captions TikTok Bold

exact_text: Today I want to show you
to make your mornings less stressful.

turns.text: Add English subtitles to this clip. Keep her original voice.
Make them big and bold for TikTok. Make the video vertical too, but keep her face in view.

item.tests: Tests revising previously created subtitles into large bold TikTok-safe captions while preserving speech, timing, and subject visibility.

answer_sheet.Which subtitles to change: The English subtitles you just added to talk-one.mp4.
answer_sheet.Text and language: Keep the same complete English transcription; only change its styling and layout.
answer_sheet.Caption styling: Big and bold. Font and colors are your call, with strong contrast.
answer_sheet.Placement: Keep captions clear of her face and away from TikTok's bottom and right-side controls.
answer_sheet.Length and audio: Keep all 10 seconds and her original English voice; no added audio.
answer_sheet.Reframing: Your call how to fit the source into vertical, as long as her face stays visible and undistorted.

must_haves: The final video is vertical 9:16 and retains the full 10-second source sequence.
The English captions are visibly larger and bolder than in the first version, with strong contrast against the footage.
The complete original speech remains accurately subtitled and synchronized after restyling.
Caption lines fit fully within the vertical frame and stay clear of the bottom and right-side TikTok interface areas.
The woman's face remains visible and undistorted, without captions obscuring it.
The original English voice is preserved without a dub or added music.

turns.text: Could you help me add subtitles to the clip I've attached? I tend to overthink little edits like this, which is why I'm asking for help rather than trying to sort it out myself. The subtitles should be in English, and please keep her original voice. I'm just hoping I'll feel good about sharing it once it's done.

dialog.agent:
Absolutely—I can add clean, readable English subtitles while keeping her original voice unchanged.

Just two details before I start: **how long is the clip, and is she speaking English already or another language?** I’ll keep the styling simple so you don’t have to fuss over the little choices.
dialog.user: It’s 10 seconds long, and she’s already speaking English. Please keep the full clip and her original voice, with no added audio. It’s for TikTok in vertical 9:16, and free-tier 480p is fine.

turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the subtitles because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No output was created, and your original clip is unchanged.

Once credits are available, I can retry with simple English subtitles across all 10 seconds, preserving her original voice with no added audio.

Got it: **big, bold English subtitles** and a **vertical 9:16 crop that keeps her face in view**, retaining all 10 seconds and her original voice, with no added audio.

The insufficient-credit block still prevents me from making the edits. Nothing has been changed or generated yet.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
I tried again with large, bold subtitles, but Magic Hour still refused the job because of **insufficient credits**. No edited video was created.

You can still do this free in TikTok:
1. Upload the full 10-second clip and choose **9:16**, repositioning the frame to keep her face visible.
2. Turn on **English auto-captions**, check the wording, and use large, bold white text with a black outline.
3. Place captions above the bottom controls, clear of her face.
4. Keep **original sound** on and don’t add music.

The free-plan settings are supported—the credit balance is what’s blocking generation.
